YOUR DATA, YOUR WORKSPACE

Bring your spend together.

Import a CSV to explore your own business units and suppliers. Files are processed in this browser and stay in memory until you refresh.

Required columns

month,business_unit,vendor,category,amount_myr

Use YYYY-MM dates and numbers such as 12500.50. Negative credits are supported. Identical month / unit / supplier / category rows are combined. Supplier names match after trimming and lowercasing.
